module "S2_DynamicConditional.dss"

product 0 Material "M_S2_DynamicConditional" backend=Graph
  %0 = Constant(Value=(0.9)) : float @L7:C50 "Rough"
  %1 = Reflected[Slab](Roughness=%0) : Substrate @L7:C23 "Rough"
  %2 = Constant(Value=(0.1)) : float @L8:C51 "Smooth"
  %3 = Reflected[Slab](Roughness=%2) : Substrate @L8:C24 "Smooth"
  %4 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(0.75), ParameterName="Blend", SortPriority=0) : float @L3:C1 "Blend"
  %5 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L9:C31 "FrontMaterial"
  %6 = Greater(%4, %5) : bool @L9:C23 "FrontMaterial"
  %7 = Convert(%6) : float @L9:C23 "FrontMaterial"
  %8 = Reflected[Select](A=%1, B=%3, SelectValue=%7) : Substrate @L9:C23 "FrontMaterial"
  %9 = MaterialSink(FrontMaterial=%8) @L5:C1
  sink %9
